entries.title: Jonah 3:1
segments: ¶Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah the second time, saying,

entries.title: Jonah 3:2
segments: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I tell you."

entries.title: Jonah 3:3
segments: So Jonah arose and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, a three-day journey [in extent].

entries.title: Jonah 3:4
segments: And Jonah began to enter the city on the first day's walk. Then he cried out and said, "Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!"

entries.title: Jonah 3:5
segments: ¶So the people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest to the least of them.

entries.title: Jonah 3:6
segments: Then word came to the king of Nineveh; and he arose from his throne and laid aside his robe, covered [himself] with sackcloth and sat in ashes.

entries.title: Jonah 3:7
segments: And he caused [it] to be proclaimed and published throughout Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything; do not let them eat, or drink water.

entries.title: Jonah 3:8
segments: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily to God; yes, let every one turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

entries.title: Jonah 3:9
segments: Who can tell [if] God will turn and relent, and turn away from His fierce anger, so that we may not perish?

entries.title: Jonah 3:10
segments: Then God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God relented from the disaster that He had said He would bring upon them, and He did not do it.
